newsitem.title: USA: Computer Data unit gets $310 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Computer Data unit gets $310 million contract.

text.p: Computer Data Systems Inc. said Wednesday that a division won a U.S. government contract with a potential value of $310 million.

The division, CDSI Information Technology Solutions Co., was awarded the contract by the General Services Administration in Fort Worth, Texas, to provide risk analysis and security-related information system services.
The company said that if all options of the contract are exercised, it would run through May 2002, with a potential value of $310 million.
Computer Data's stock jumped 50 cents to $36.75 on the Nasdaq.
